title: Environment
description: An environment within a project, such as production or staging.

_id.description: The unique identifier of this environment.

name.description: The human-readable name of the environment.

color.description: The color swatch for the environment in the dashboard.

apiKey.description: The SDK key for server-side SDKs.

mobileKey.description: The mobile key for mobile SDKs.

defaultTtl.description: The default time-to-live in minutes for flag values.

secureMode.description: Whether secure mode is enabled for this environment.
